jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Architect
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**About Crowe Studio**

Crowe Studio is a business unit dedicated to helping clients scale smarter, transform faster, and lead in a platform-driven economy. Built for speed and flexibility, Crowe Studio operates outside the constraints of traditional professional services delivery models, giving clients access to cross-disciplinary innovation, embedded AI capabilities, and global delivery resources—all in service of solving complex business challenges in faster, smarter ways.

Through Crowe Studio, the firm provides clients with an innovation partner focused on rapid execution, deep technology integration, and high-impact results. We’re building the next generation of business models for professional services, where human expertise and AI are embedded within clients’ operations to drive ongoing impact, not just deliver isolated projects.

As a member of Crowe Studio, you will help distinguish Crowe in the market and drive the firm’s technology and innovation strategy. The future is powered by AI—come build it with us.

**About Forward Deployed Engineering**

The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Practice drives AI transformation through embedded consulting and engineering, enabling clients to accelerate delivery, scale solutions, and capture value faster. Our approach helps companies prove AI in their own environments, delivering results in weeks, not months.

We embed our Forward Deployed Engineers side-by-side with client teams to spot opportunities, make AI concepts real, and deploy solutions rapidly. Unlike traditional consulting approaches that rely on documented requirements and lengthy development cycles, FDEs blend engineering, product thinking, workflow design, and business understanding to achieve shared, outcome-driven ownership until measurable results are achieved.

Our engagements range from 2-hour AI Immersion Labs that turn AI noise into real use cases, to multi-week Proof of Value Sprints that prototype and deploy game-changing AI solutions. We help companies de-risk AI adoption while demonstrating solid ROI.

**About the Team**

* **We invest in expertise**. You’ll have the time, space, and support to go deep on client engagements and build lasting technical and strategic mastery. You’ll work with cross-functional teams and client teams as a trusted advisor and domain expert.
* **We believe in continuous growth**. Our team is committed to professional development and knowledge-sharing.
* **We protect balance**. Our distributed team culture is grounded in trust and flexibility. We offer unlimited PTO, a flexible remote work policy, and a supportive environment that prioritizes sustainable, long-term performance.

**About the Role**

As a Forward Deployed AI Architect (Manager), you will serve as a hands-on technical authority responsible for designing, developing, and delivering innovative, production-ready AI solutions for our clients. You will own solution architecture, technical feasibility, engineering quality, and production readiness while remaining actively involved in coding, prototyping, and complex technical problem-solving.

Working within Crowe Studio's Forward Deployed Engineering practice, you will collaborate directly with clients and cross-functional teams to translate complex business challenges into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI applications. Your work will span agentic AI systems, generative AI applications, enterprise integrations, cloud-native architectures, and production deployments.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who wants to expand their technical leadership and architectural influence without moving away from hands-on engineering. You will guide technical decisions, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and communicate architectural tradeoffs with confidence. You will also be empowered to challenge technical approaches that introduce unacceptable risk or will not meet production requirements.

**What You’ll Do**

* Architect and develop end-to-end applied AI solutions, including generative AI applications, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI-enabled enterprise workflows.
* Lead solution architecture for AI build and proof-of-concept engagements, ensuring solutions are technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives.
* Remain hands-on across solution development, including application coding, data integration, prototyping, debugging, and technical implementation.
* Design and implement cloud-native AI solutions using Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and relevant AI platforms and services.
* Define architecture and integration patterns for large language models (LLMs), vector databases, APIs, microservices, enterprise data platforms, and client systems.
* Take ownership of technical feasibility, solution design decisions, and build quality from initial discovery through production deployment.
* Guide solutions through Architecture Review Board processes, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, responsible AI principles, and production readiness expectations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**  
Vestwell is a fintech company that powers workplace retirement plans, state-sponsored savings programs, and 529 education and ABLE savings accounts. Our platform is a set of distributed, event-driven services that handle contributions, investments, and withdrawals, and that integrate with banking, recordkeeping, and payment partners. Because it moves real people's money, correctness, security, and auditability are part of the job.  
  
We build with AI agents as a core part of our workflow. Our engineers direct agents to plan, write, test, and refactor code, and they stay accountable for every decision and every line that ships.  
  
As a Software Engineer, you independently deliver well-scoped features across the stack, working with AI agents every day. You've built backends in any modern language and frontends in Angular or React.  
  
**What Will You Be Doing?**

* Independently deliver well-scoped features and fixes, from implementation through testing and release, with normal collaboration and review from your team and product manager.
* Break your work into small, clear steps and give agents enough context to do them well, using our in-house AI skills and workflows.
* Evaluate the conclusions and decisions AI agents make. Provide oversight to ensure correctness, and steer them toward good, complete outcomes.
* Learn our application designs and development best practices, and review AI-produced code against our standards.
* Ask clarifying questions when a requirement is vague or doesn't add up, before you start building.
* Compare a couple of approaches before you commit to one, and be ready to explain why you chose it.
* Write unit tests for the code you ship, and keep the CI pipeline green.
* Validate teammates' work during code review: pull down the change, run it, and confirm the feature actually works. Don't stop at reading the diff.

**Requirements**  
The Necessities

* 3+ years building production software.
* Experience shipping full-stack features to production: REST APIs, data models, and frontend forms and state. The backend can be in any language; the frontend should be in **Angular** or **React**.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Some exposure to **AWS**, message queues, or event-driven systems.
* Experience writing unit tests and working with CI/CD.
* Regular use of AI coding tools in your work, and a clear sense of where they help and where they get things wrong.
* Curiosity and healthy skepticism: you want to understand why code works, not just that it seems to.

The Extras

* Experience with **.NET (C#)**.
* Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.

This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.  
  
The expected base salary range for this position is $135K - $150K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

  

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.

*Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  
  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Rippling’s Emerging Products teams which span Core Experience, Spend, and IT Products build deeply integrated systems across financial operations, IT administration, employee lifecycle automation, and enterprise security. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data.

=====================

Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This

**The role**
============

This is a sales role, not a delivery one. You join an opportunity when it reaches solution validation and are its technical owner for the rest of the sales cycle, as part of the team that works the deal: the Account Executive, who owns the deal and orchestrates it; the Reimaginer Consultants, who build the client's baseline and the business case; the prototyping teams, who build and demo the proof; the Sales Engineer, who owns the functional requirements; and the Bid Manager, who runs RFP responses.

**What you will own**

* The IT discussion during solution validation: how Lyzr fits the client's architecture, systems and data, how it is deployed, and how it integrates.

* Security: answering security questionnaires and InfoSec reviews with the Sales Engineer, and taking the client's security and risk teams through how the platform handles their data.

* The client's sandbox or environment, set up with the Sales Engineer so the client can try Lyzr on its own ground.

* The technical answers inside RFP, RFX and RFI responses, written for the Bid Manager, who runs the response end to end.

* The technical side of the business case, as it goes through the client's IT, security and risk reviews.

* Knowing when a question needs platform engineering, and keeping the deal team informed of where the technical conversation stands.

**What will make you win this role**
====================================

* 8 years or more in solutions architecture, pre-sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise software, with time spent on the selling side of complex deals.

* Hands-on depth in at least one of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and in enterprise integration: APIs, identity and single sign-on, data platforms and networking.

* A working understanding of large language models, retrieval, and how AI agents are built, orchestrated and governed in production.

* Fluency in enterprise security and compliance - SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA - and experience answering security questionnaires and leading InfoSec reviews.

* Experience with SaaS, private cloud and on-premises deployment, and the trade-offs a client weighs between them.

* The ability to draw an architecture and explain it to a CIO, a CISO and an engineer in the same meeting, and to write a clear technical answer to a deadline.

Good to have

* A cloud architecture certification from AWS, Microsoft or Google.

* Experience selling into regulated industries - banking, insurance, healthcare.

**Life at Lyzr**
================

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist, Discovery & Recommendations
new_jobs.description:
### **About Us**

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

### **About the Team**

Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office.

### **You Will:**

* Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade-offs explicit between short-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other.
* Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data.
* Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months.
* Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap.
* Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality.
* Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists.

### **You Have:**

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/  
  
About Us  
Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.  
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.  
  
About the Role  
  
We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision.  
  
  
Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office.  
  
You Will  

* Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade-offs explicit between short-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other.
* Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data.
* Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months.
* Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap.
* Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality.
* Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists.

  
Perks  

* Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
* 401(k)
* Maternity & Parental Leave
* Flexible PTO
* Amazon Employee Discount

  
About the team  
Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of data scientist experience
* A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience.
* 3+ years as a data scientist in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, with hands-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails.
* Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results.
* Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R.
* A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* An MS or PhD in a quantitative field.
* Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold-start problems.
* Experience with multi-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals.
* Experience building proxy metrics for long-term outcomes, or estimating long-term effects from long-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling).
* Experience with two-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply.
* Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short-form video, social or marketplaces.
* Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!).

new_jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, ML, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Science, Statistics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
* Applied experience with machine learning, preferably modern deep learning techniques (e.g., Transformers, Diffusion, LLMs).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with training, evaluating, and interpreting large language models.
* Experience in computer vision, audio processing, and media analysis.
* Experience working with large and noisy datasets.
* Proven ability to design and execute independent research projects.
* Strong publication record in top machine learning or computer vision conferences or journals (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ICCV, CVPR, ECCV).

**About the job**
-----------------

Artificial Intelligence could be one of humanity’s most useful inventions. At DeepMind, we’re a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts and more, working together to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, and collaborate with others on critical challenges, ensuring safety and ethics are the highest priority.

We’re a dedicated scientific community, committed to “solving intelligence” and ensuring our technology is used for widespread public benefit. We’ve built a supportive and versatile environment where collaboration is encouraged and learning is shared freely. We don’t set limits based on what others think is possible or impossible. We drive ourselves and inspire each other to push boundaries and achieve ambitious goals.

As a Research Engineer, you will handle media forensics and problems in multimodal perception, reasoning, and visual explainability. You will join a collaborative team of machine learning researchers, engineers, and domain specialists operating in a fast-moving, adversarial landscape where generative capabilities evolve continuously. Success in this role blends strong empirical engineering with scientific curiosity: designing scalable architectures, investigating why models succeed or fail on unseen distributions, and shaping new research directions across multimodal AI.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design and scale architectures across vision, video, and audio (adapting foundation models and specialized classifiers) to detect and characterize synthetic or manipulated media.
* Develop calibrated confidence estimation, selective prediction, and few-shot or test-time adaptation for reliability under real-world transformations and unseen generative families.
* Build models for visual, acoustic, and cross-modal reasoning that localize semantic edits, synthesize provenance signals, and produce interpretable explanations.
* Build large-scale training curricula, synthetic-to-real transfer recipes, and benchmarks over noisy, adversarial, web-scale distributions.
* Identify high-impact media provenance opportunities, partnering across DeepMind and Google surfaces to publish novel research and deploy at scale.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.title: Data Scientist, Finance
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is a unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.

**The Team**
------------

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

* Founded and exited successful companies
* Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
* Won IMO and IOI gold medals
* Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, having raised $50M from Sequoia (Alfred Lin), General Catalyst (Hemant Taneja), Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.

**Core Principles**
-------------------

### **Taste:** ***Craft beautiful experiences.***

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.

### **Obsession:** ***Commit unreasonably.***

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.

### **Action:** ***Get it done.***

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.

**Role**
--------

As a Finance Data Scientist at Rox, you will own the numbers that explain what it costs to run an agentic product and what we earn from it. Every agent action has a real cost in models, enrichment and infrastructure. Your work tells the company which products and customers are profitable, why, and what to change.

You will sit between Finance, Engineering and GTM. You will build the cost and margin models, reconcile contracts and revenue across systems, catch cost anomalies before they reach the P&L, and give leadership a view of unit economics they can run the business on.

This is a high-ownership role on a small data team. You will be as comfortable in a dbt model as in a month-end close conversation, and you will be expected to push back with evidence when a number does not tie.

You'll be one of Rox's first dedicated data hires. It's an opportunity to help build an agile data function from the ground up at an early-stage, fast-growing company.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Own COGS reporting end to end: LLM, enrichment vendor and infrastructure costs.
* Build and maintain gross margin reporting by product and customer, tied out to the general ledger and delivered to Finance and leadership on a set cadence.
* Track cost per action and its drivers, and partner with Engineering to triage the most expensive workloads and push margins higher.
* Run cost anomaly detection so that a model change, a vendor price change or a runaway workflow is flagged in days, not at month end.
* Build the single source of truth for contracts, ARR and revenue across the CRM, the ERP and the warehouse, including the closed-won to ARR process.
* Model consumption against contract commitments to support pricing, packaging, overage and renewal decisions.
* Produce the repeatable business metrics pack for the board and investors: ARR, net retention, gross margin and unit economics, with definitions that hold up to diligence.
* Build and maintain the dbt models and Snowflake pipelines behind all of the above, including vendor billing and ERP data ingestion.

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Required**

* Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance)
* 2 to 5+ years in analytics, FP&A, strategic finance or data science at a fast-growing company, with direct ownership of cost, margin or revenue models
* Strong SQL and Python, comfortable with large, messy billing, metering and usage data
* Working knowledge of SaaS finance: ARR, revenue recognition basics, COGS versus opex, gross margin and net retention
* Experience with dbt and a modern warehouse, and with dashboards in Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Mode or equivalent
* A reconciliation habit: you tie numbers to source systems and can explain every variance
* Able to explain a cost or margin finding to both an engineer and a CFO
* High energy, "no job is too small" mentality, and extreme ownership
* Located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco

### **Preferred**

* Experience at a consumption or usage-based business (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Snowflake), with fluency in usage metering and unit economics
* Experience with the cost structure of AI products: token pricing, model routing and third-party data vendors
* Experience with ERP and billing systems, and with getting their data into a warehouse
* Experience supporting a fundraise, audit or board reporting cycle
* Experience with pricing and packaging analysis

San Francisco, CA

Compensation Range: $165K - $250K

Build the product where anyone with expertise trains their own intelligence. Today that takes a builder and a benchmark. We're heading to a product where a lawyer or a banker describes what good looks like, and the platform does the research for them.

**About Trajectory**
--------------------

Trajectory is a research and product lab building the platform for continual learning, where agents get smarter with every interaction.

AI is the most capable software ever built, and the least able to learn. Every correction and edit that happens in a product evaporates at the next session. Our platform turns the signal already sitting in product usage into continuously post-trained models, and lets anyone train a large-scale model with just a few agent prompts. We just launched self-serve and work with Harvey, Rogo, Decagon, and NVIDIA.

Our researchers worked on Gemini 3 at DeepMind and GPT-4o at OpenAI, and our product team comes from Apple Vision Pro, Netflix, and Stripe. We've raised $60M in a Sequoia-led Series A, alongside Conviction, Bessemer, NVIDIA, Jeff Dean, and Fei-Fei Li.

**The role**
------------

Trajectory makes it simple to train a model on production data. You can do it from the web app, with one click to train and evaluate and a live view of every run, or by connecting a coding agent and doing the same thing with a couple of prompts. As a Product Engineer, you'll build both of those interfaces, and both should be equally clean.

You'll iterate quickly on feedback from the customers we work with every week, and work directly with our researchers to bring new research paradigms from a customer demo into the mainline product.

* Build the platform frontend: training and eval flows, run monitoring, model comparison, and the in-platform agent.

---------------

Annapurna Labs (our organization) designs silicon and software that accelerates innovation. Customers choose us to create cloud solutions that solve challenges that were unimaginable a short time ago—even yesterday. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.  
  
LibNVMe is the customer-facing front-end interface for local and remote storage on EC2 instances, with a focus on HW/SW co-design and performance optimization.  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join the LibNVMe team. You will design, build, and own features across the storage software stack, from optimizing storage protocols to keeping foundational EC2 infrastructure reliable. This is high-ownership work: your code runs on Nitro Cards in millions of EC2 servers, serving customers who demand the best storage performance.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop features for LibNVMe, the customer-facing front-end interface for EC2 local storage (instance store) and remote storage (Amazon EBS) on Nitro Cards.
* Build deep knowledge of the NVMe specification and the I/O path, and use it to improve performance and reliability.
* Work with Annapurna Labs hardware and firmware engineers to implement and test software/hardware interfaces.
* Develop and maintain the drivers and libraries that give storage applications simple, secure APIs to Nitro Card hardware.
* Work with AWS storage service teams to deliver features and resolve issues, diving into their code when needed.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code, contribute to design and code reviews, and help onboard new teammates.
* Contribute to operational excellence: improve observability and debuggability, take part in the on-call rotation, and help resolve incidents and their follow-ups.

  
A day in the life  
Your day might include writing and reviewing code, working with hardware and firmware engineers on new features, or tracking down a performance bottleneck. You'll also help partner teams debug issues that span their stack and ours, and learn from senior engineers along the way.

The LibNVMe team is part of Annapurna Labs, which builds the custom silicon and software behind the AWS Nitro System. We work closely with AWS storage, hardware, and firmware teams, and we value ownership, mentorship, and helping each engineer grow.

**The Role**
------------

As an Infrastructure Engineer at Triumph, you'll own the foundation that everything else runs on. Until now, our infrastructure has been built and maintained by the core engineering team alongside everything else — you'll be on the team whose mandate is to make our foundation fast, observable, and bulletproof. Our platform touches gaming, finance, and social at scale, which means there's no margin for downtime. You'll define how we build, ship, and scale from the ground up — CI/CD pipelines, IaC, data layer, orchestration, telemetry, and the glue in between. You’ll be part of a team empowering Triumph to grow and scale towards our next order of magnitude.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Set the standards, tooling, and practices that teams and future hires will build on.
* Own and evolve our CI/CD pipelines, making it fast and safe for a growing team to ship continuously.
* Take end-to-end ownership of scaling our backend systems, identifying bottlenecks before they become incidents and designing for the next 10x rather than the last one.
* Drive our database strategy — query optimization, connection pooling, replication and read routing, schema evolution, and keeping our highest-traffic data paths healthy under load.
* Build out observability and telemetry so the team can see, understand, and act on system behavior in real time — metrics, tracing, structured logging, and meaningful alerting.
* Partner with backend engineers to harden the systems that power our core business, from incident response to the architectural decisions that prevent the next one.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of experience operating and scaling large production systems, with a track record of ownership — you don't just build it, you keep it healthy.
* Strong Database knowledge, bonus points for Postgres. You understand query planning, indexing, connection management, and what actually breaks at scale (Go and AlloyDB experience is a plus).
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Fluency with observability and telemetry tooling, and an instinct for what to measure.
* Comfort being the first and only person in a function — you're excited to set direction rather than inherit it, and you drive work to completion without a playbook handed to you.
* Tenacity, pragmatism, and high agency — you prioritize the most impactful work and drive it to completion.
* Adaptable, AI has supercharged development speeds and it’s no different at Triumph. Engineering moves quickly here and infra needs to stay ahead of evolving product needs as we grow.

**Why Triumph?**
----------------

* High growth. Build a high-scale consumer platform that touches gaming, finance, and social with the autonomy to set our infrastructure direction. (16x year over year growth).
* High agency. As part of a rapidly growing team, you'll own a large surface area from day one, with significant opportunity for leadership and growth.
* High energy. You’ll be joining a team of people who are passionate about the communities on our products and excited to ship new features.
* Competitive salary and benefits. $400/mo lunch credit, healthcare, vision, dental, 401k, etc.

Our team gathers 5 days a week at Triumph's headquarters at Levi's Plaza in San Francisco.

Compensation Range: $200K - $400K

new_jobs.title: Agent Infrastructure Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About HeyGen**
----------------

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.  
Learn more at www.heygen.com. .

**About the Agentic Video team**
--------------------------------

The Agentic Video team owns HyperFrames which is our open-source framework for turning code into video. Our agent’s videos are just an HTML composition. Agents author it and humans collaborate with agents in our Studio to refine it before it renders deterministically to video. Since launching in April 2026, HyperFrames has grown to nearly 90,000 GitHub stars. More than 350,000 developers use it every week to render over 7 million videos, and most of them work through a coding agent.

Now we're building on top of it by creating the best coding agents for video and a collaborative video ecosystem for teams. These agents run in our cloud on a user's behalf as well as locally on a developer's own machine. They write and run code, generate media, and then hand their work to a cloud rendering platform that turns it into finished video at scale.

**About the role**
------------------

You will build and own the infrastructure that lets HyperFrames agents run safely and reliably, wherever they run. That covers:

* our sandboxing platform
* durable execution for long-running agent sessions
* governance and security for agents in our cloud and on users' machines
* HyperFrames cloud rendering

This is a senior, high-ownership role. Much of the work is greenfield, and you will set the technical direction and roadmap for agent infrastructure as well as execute on it.

You'll work closely with the engineers building our agents, the team behind the open-source framework, and our core engineering and research teams.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own the sandboxing platform.** Every agent session writes and runs code: HTML, JavaScript, shell commands and headless browsers. You'll design the isolation model using microVMs and kernel sandboxes (Firecracker, Kata, gVisor or similar), Linux namespaces and cgroups. You'll own network egress policy and short-lived, least-privilege credentials for every run.
* **Make agent execution durable.** Ensure resumable execution that checkpoints model calls and tool invocations, so an agent session survives pod failures, deploys and retries without losing the user's work.
* **Govern agents in the cloud and on the desktop.** Decide and enforce what an agent may touch: tools, files, network access and credentials. Build the permission, policy and audit layer for cloud agents and for our local agent running on users' machines.
* **Run code-to-video rendering at scale.** Own HyperFrames cloud rendering: the fleet of headless browsers and encoders behind millions of weekly renders. Drive down cold start, render time and cost per render, and keep output deterministic.
* **Make every run observable.** Trace each agent run end to end, from prompt through model calls, tool calls and render. Feed that data into the evaluation pipelines we use to measure quality.
* **Set the bar.** Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, own reliability and on-call for the platform, and decide what we build versus buy.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **You have built and operated infrastructure that runs untrusted code at scale.** For example: code-execution sandboxes, agent platforms, CI runners, serverless or function platforms, or notebook and compute backends. We want to hear about an incident you handled and what you changed afterward.
* **You know isolation deeply.** You are fluent in containers and Kubernetes and the security boundaries around them: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, network policy, and at least one of Firecracker, Kata, gVisor, or Sysbox. You can reason about multi-tenant risk and the blast radius of running someone else's code.
* **You build distributed systems that recover from failure.** You have shipped durable or resumable execution, such as Temporal or a checkpointing workflow engine, and you think carefully about concurrency, race conditions, and retries.
* **You care about performance.** You have measured and reduced cold-start time, p99 latency, or cost per job on a production system.
* **You operate at a senior or staff level.** You have 5+ years of software engineering experience. You have led the technical design of a platform other teams depend on, and you are strong in Python or TypeScript.
* **You take ownership.** You do not wait for a spec. You find the most important problem, fix it, and tell people what changed.

A degree in computer science or a related field is welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You have run a code-sandbox or agent-execution product, at a company like E2B, Modal, Daytona, Fly.io, or Cloudflare, or inside a large AI lab.
* You have built tool or MCP integrations, retrieval systems, or permission layers for AI agents.
* You have built tracing or evaluation pipelines for LLM systems, for example with OpenTelemetry.
* You have run headless-browser or media workloads at scale (Chrome/Puppeteer, FFmpeg, GPU encoding). Cloud rendering is now part of the job.
* You have built security or policy tooling that runs on developer machines. That covers the local-agent governance work.
* You maintain or contribute to a widely used open-source project.

**Show us something you've built**
----------------------------------

With your application, please include a short note (a few sentences is fine) about infrastructure you have built and run in production: a sandbox, a runner, a workflow engine, or an agent p

new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Commercial Aviation
new_jobs.description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears and turns it into automated debrief intelligence, sortie-level awareness that has never existed before. You're building the platform that makes that happen.

Navi is live at the U.S. Air Force Test Pilot School, Embry-Riddle, United Aviate, Sling Pilot Academy and Delta State University. You'll bring it to the next school, and make the one after that faster.

**On site with customers 25 to 40% of the time**

**About the role**
==================

At a flight school, Navi is a device in every aircraft, a debrief after every lesson, and the picture the chief instructor, director of operations and safety officer run the school on. Forward deployed engineers make that work at each customer.

You'll spend time at flight schools, universities and airline pathway programs: on the ramp, in dispatch and in the briefing room. Then you'll write the production code that turns what you saw into product, in the same codebase every customer runs. You'll own a set of customers end to end, from the devices in their aircraft to the instructors and staff who use what comes out.

**Problems you'll own**
=======================

**Bring a school online.** Install recording devices across a fleet. Connect avionics (Garmin G1000 and G3X, piston and turbine engines) and the school's scheduling and maintenance systems. Map roles and permissions to how the school actually runs: chief instructors, stage check pilots, dispatchers, maintenance and students.

**Keep every flight recorded.** Devices live in hot cockpits on vibrating panels, with SD cards and cables that fail. When a student says their flight never showed up, you'll trace it from the aircraft through the ingest pipeline to storage, recover it, and fix the reason it went missing. Then you'll build the alerts and troubleshooting guides that catch the next failing device before a week of flights goes unrecorded.

**Make the debrief right for their aircraft and procedures.** A turbine logs torque and percent power; a piston logs manifold pressure. One school's stabilized approach criteria aren't another's. You'll tune exceedances, SOP adherence and maneuver detection to each fleet and each operation, as configuration where you can and code where you must.

**Build what leaders run the school on.** Student progress and completion forecasts, stalled students, upcoming stage checks and checkrides, aircraft hours to the next inspection, open squawks. You'll find the question a chief instructor or director of operations asks every Monday morning and make Navi answer it.

**Make safety proactive.** Every exceedance, unstable approach and trend across every flight, not only the ones someone reported. You'll turn flight data and safety reports into the picture a safety officer runs their SMS on.

**Know whether it worked.** Every feature ships with product analytics, so you can tell which schools and which roles use it and where people drop off. Adoption is the scoreboard.

**Earn trust with student data.** Students see their own progress without comparisons to classmates, and names stay blurred on shared screens. You'll make the careful calls on how data about people is shown.

**About you**
=============

* 3+ years shipping production software, in any programming language. You've owned a system in production end to end.
* You debug across the whole stack: a device in an aircraft, a queue, a database, a web page.
* Comfortable with flight data or other real-world time series: sampling rates, units, gaps and bad sensors.
* You can run a meeting with a chief instructor and a director of operations and come back with the right problem, not just the one they named.
* You build with AI coding agents every day, and you know how to check their work: tests, measurements and a second look before anything ships.
* You're comfortable owning outcomes when the roadmap isn't written yet.
* Able to travel to customer sites regularly.

**Nice to have**
================

* A pilot certificate, and a CFI or CFII even more
* Flight school operations: Part 141 and Part 61 training, stage checks, scheduling and maintenance software
* Avionics and engine data: Garmin G1000 and G3X logs, ADS-B
* Airline training and safety programs: AQP, FOQA/FDM, SMS
* Devices in the field: embedded Linux, IoT fleets, cellular connectivity
* Hands-on aviation work: an A&P certificate, a dispatcher certificate or line service

**What this role is not**
=========================

Not a sales engineer running demos. Not support working a ticket queue. Not a consultant handing over a report. You write production code that ships to every customer, and you're the reason it works where it lands.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

Most of what happens on a training flight is never reviewed. An instructor has minutes between lessons, and a chief instructor can learn that a student was struggling weeks after it started. Navi turns every flight into something a student can learn from and a school can act on. Getting it right at each school is how flight training gets safer and faster for everyone who comes after.

**What you'll get**
===================

* Early-stage equity: real ownership in a category-defining company
* Flight training: earn your pilot's license and build with true domain expertise
* Time on the ramp with the people who use what you build
* A role that grows into leading Navi's commercial deployments as we scale

**How we work**
===============

* **Find a way.** We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.
* **Creativity over control.** First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.
* **Update fast.** Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.
* **Intensity with focus.** We work hard because the mission demands it

**Job Description:**

**About Crowe Studio**

Crowe Studio is a business unit dedicated to helping clients scale smarter, transform faster, and lead in a platform-driven economy. Built for speed and flexibility, Crowe Studio operates outside the constraints of traditional professional services delivery models, giving clients access to cross-disciplinary innovation, embedded AI capabilities, and global delivery resources—all in service of solving complex business challenges in faster, smarter ways.

Through Crowe Studio, the firm provides clients with an innovation partner focused on rapid execution, deep technology integration, and high-impact results. As a member of Crowe Studio, you will help distinguish Crowe in the market and drive the firm’s technology and innovation strategy. The future is powered by AI—come build it with us.

The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Practice drives AI transformation through embedded consulting and engineering, enabling clients to accelerate delivery, scale solutions, and capture value faster. Our approach helps companies prove AI in their own environments, delivering results in weeks, not months.

We embed our Forward Deployed Engineers side-by-side with client teams to spot opportunities, make AI concepts real, and deploy solutions rapidly. Unlike traditional consulting approaches that rely on documented requirements and lengthy development cycles, FDEs blend engineering, product thinking, workflow design, and business understanding to achieve shared, outcome-driven ownership until measurable results are achieved.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**  
Vestwell is a fintech company that powers workplace retirement plans, state-sponsored savings programs, and 529 education and ABLE savings accounts. Our platform is a set of distributed, event-driven services that handle contributions, investments, and withdrawals, and that integrate with banking, recordkeeping, and payment partners. Because it moves real people's money, correctness, security, and auditability are part of the job.  
  
We build with AI agents as a core part of our workflow. Our engineers direct agents to plan, write, test, and refactor code, and they stay accountable for every decision and every line that ships.  
  
As a Software Engineer, you independently deliver well-scoped features across the stack, working with AI agents every day. You've built backends in any modern language and frontends in Angular or React.  
  
**What Will You Be Doing?**

* Independently deliver well-scoped features and fixes, from implementation through testing and release, with normal collaboration and review from your team and product manager.
* Break your work into small, clear steps and give agents enough context to do them well, using our in-house AI skills and workflows.
* Evaluate the conclusions and decisions AI agents make. Provide oversight to ensure correctness, and steer them toward good, complete outcomes.
* Learn our application designs and development best practices, and review AI-produced code against our standards.
* Ask clarifying questions when a requirement is vague or doesn't add up, before you start building.
* Compare a couple of approaches before you commit to one, and be ready to explain why you chose it.
* Write unit tests for the code you ship, and keep the CI pipeline green.
* Validate teammates' work during code review: pull down the change, run it, and confirm the feature actually works. Don't stop at reading the diff.

**Requirements**  
The Necessities

* 3+ years building production software.
* Experience shipping full-stack features to production: REST APIs, data models, and frontend forms and state. The backend can be in any language; the frontend should be in **Angular** or **React**.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Some exposure to **AWS**, message queues, or event-driven systems.
* Experience writing unit tests and working with CI/CD.
* Regular use of AI coding tools in your work, and a clear sense of where they help and where they get things wrong.
* Curiosity and healthy skepticism: you want to understand why code works, not just that it seems to.

The Extras

* Experience with **.NET (C#)**.
* Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.

This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.  
  
The expected base salary range for this position is $135K - $150K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

  

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.

Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  
  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  
  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  
  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role:**
-------------------

Rippling’s Emerging Products teams which span Core Experience, Spend, and IT Products build deeply integrated systems across financial operations, IT administration, employee lifecycle automation, and enterprise security. These are high-trust product areas where reliability, correctness, security, and scale are critical.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data.

This role also supports Rippling’s expansion of AI-powered workflows across HR, IT, Finance, Spend, and core platform experiences. You’ll help make AI capabilities safe, reliable, explainable, auditable, and enterprise-ready, while ensuring customers have the trust, transparency, and control needed to adopt automation at scale.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Design, implement, and test reliable backend services and APIs that power core product features and business logic at scale.
* Work across key technical domains, including API design, data modeling, event modeling, and optimizing service performance.
* Own the development lifecycle for defined features, from implementation and testing to deployment, monitoring, and support in a production environment.
* Effectively integrate into cross-functional teams, contribute to technical discovery, and rapidly learn from code and system feedback.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 2+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer, preferably with Python, Go, or a similar production language, and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).
* Care about business impact, balancing technical craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly.
* Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs.
* Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders.

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. 135,000 - 225,000 USD per year (US Tier 1)

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect - PreSales
new_jobs.description:
**Lyzr, in a minute**
=====================

Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day-to-day use. Today, 500+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.

Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This

**The role**
============

This is a sales role, not a delivery one. You join an opportunity when it reaches solution validation and are its technical owner for the rest of the sales cycle, as part of the team that works the deal: the Account Executive, who owns the deal and orchestrates it; the Reimaginer Consultants, who build the client's baseline and the business case; the prototyping teams, who build and demo the proof; the Sales Engineer, who owns the functional requirements; and the Bid Manager, who runs RFP responses.

**What you will own**

* The IT discussion during solution validation: how Lyzr fits the client's architecture, systems and data, how it is deployed, and how it integrates.

* Security: answering security questionnaires and InfoSec reviews with the Sales Engineer, and taking the client's security and risk teams through how the platform handles their data.

* The client's sandbox or environment, set up with the Sales Engineer so the client can try Lyzr on its own ground.

* The technical answers inside RFP, RFX and RFI responses, written for the Bid Manager, who runs the response end to end.

* The technical side of the business case, as it goes through the client's IT, security and risk reviews.

* Knowing when a question needs platform engineering, and keeping the deal team informed of where the technical conversation stands.

**What will make you win this role**
====================================

* 8 years or more in solutions architecture, pre-sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise software, with time spent on the selling side of complex deals.

* Hands-on depth in at least one of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and in enterprise integration: APIs, identity and single sign-on, data platforms and networking.

* A working understanding of large language models, retrieval, and how AI agents are built, orchestrated and governed in production.

* Fluency in enterprise security and compliance - SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA - and experience answering security questionnaires and leading InfoSec reviews.

* Experience with SaaS, private cloud and on-premises deployment, and the trade-offs a client weighs between them.

* The ability to draw an architecture and explain it to a CIO, a CISO and an engineer in the same meeting, and to write a clear technical answer to a deadline.

Good to have

* A cloud architecture certification from AWS, Microsoft or Google.

* Experience selling into regulated industries - banking, insurance, healthcare.

**Life at Lyzr**
================

* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools — you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators — the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes — and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.
